name: Librarian illustrated encounter

assets.role: Original painted architecture: windows, shelves, ladders, empty balcony and clear walkway
Separate carved stone foreground below collision baseline
Original articulated Librarian with curious, impressed, preparing, casting, frustrated and satisfied face/arm groups

provenance.painted_environment: Original image generated with the OpenAI image_gen tool for Recall Rally on 2026-10-30; optimized as WebP, no third-party source images. Original PNG retained in the session generated_images directory.
provenance.prompt: Wide panoramic side-view gothic storybook library; carved walnut shelves, varied antique leather books, stained glass, brass rolling ladders, central empty balcony, blue-violet moonlight and warm candles. No characters, text or UI. Clear dark lower walkway, horizontal floor baseline at 88 percent height and carved stone foreground below it.
provenance.vector_equipment: Original project-authored SVG guardian, book page poses and foreground in scripts/draw-librarian-illustrations.py; no external fonts or borrowed assets.
provenance.hero: Existing saved hero geometry/colors/appearance from renderGameHero; opt-in semantic layer groups plus a local DOM rig. Normal shared-renderer output unchanged.

runtime: Artwork embedded by scripts/sync-librarian-art.cjs into local CSS/JS; standalone embeds both. No remote image requests. Physics/timing/grading and hitboxes unchanged. DOM limb/mood changes are presentation only; book pages use the existing canvas animation loop. Reduced motion stops optional animation.
